==How to get Full Salvo==
*You always have at least 1 Full Salvo
*Full Salvo can come with [[Wands]]
*[[Overloaded Scatter]] or [[Volley]]
==What does Full Salvo do==
*You amount of Full Salvo determients how many different [[Spells]] can be casted at once
==Expample==
[[File:Screenshot (213).png|left|256x256px]]
[[File:Screenshot (211).png|left|256x256px]]
The Wand has 1 Full Salvo on its own. When we add the 2 extra Full Salvo from [[Volley]] we get a total of 3 Full Salvo. As you can see in the second picture we can now cast 3 [[Spells]] at once. 
[[Volley]] has the extra ability to reduce Mana Cost and add [[Scatter]] to these spells for every addtional shootable [[Spell]]. In our Case we are shooting 3 Spells at once and 2 of them are additional to the 1 Full Salvo you are alwys having. So Mana Cost will be multiplied with 0.8^2 and [[Scatter]] will increase by 16°.
